results.title: Psychometric Evaluation of Large Language Model Embeddings for ...
results.content: Objective: This study evaluates LLM embeddings for personality trait prediction through four key analyses: (1) performance comparison with zero-shot methods on PANDORA Reddit data, (2) psychometric validation and correlation with LIWC (Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count) and emotion features, (3) benchmarking against traditional feature engineering approaches, and (4) assessment of model size effects (OpenAI vs BERT vs RoBERTa). Conclusions: Our findings demonstrate that LLM embeddings offer a robust alternative to zero-shot methods in personality trait analysis, capturing key linguistic patterns without requiring extensive feature engineering. Our primary work begins with experimenting with the variant of LLMs’ embedding (RoBERTa and OpenAI) to perform Big Five personality traits prediction on our custom model (BiLSTM with attention). This study establishes the efficacy of LLM embeddings in personality trait prediction, with both OpenAI and RoBERTa embeddings demonstrating superior performance compared to zero-shot inference and conventional linguistic feature-based approaches.
